chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan Za'lan, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Hammad ibn Talha, from Isa ibn Abu Mansur, who said:
Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Isa! I love that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sees you, in the period between one Hajj and the next, while you are preparing for the Hajj.'

key_terms.بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ إِلَى الْحَجِّ: between the Hajj and the Hajj (the period between pilgrimages)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended spiritual state for a Muslim between Hajj pilgrimages according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the virtue of maintaining a perpetual state of spiritual and practical readiness for the Hajj pilgrimage, ensuring that one is always prepared to answer the call of Allah between one Hajj and the next. This teaching underscores the Shia scholarly view that Hajj is not merely an annual ritual but a continuous state of devotion and preparedness, reflecting the concept of *istidraj* in readiness for divine command. The emphasis on being seen by Allah in this state highlights the importance of sincerity and constant vigilance in worship.
